scope: Source-pinned implementation and local development controls only; existing toy fixture and synthetic reports are explicitly separate from the requested admitted research benchmark.
statement: Source 3ddc3238 adds actual-column BLAKE3 identities to Rust CLI reports and a producer-side scalar relation-yield alignment helper. It rejects mismatched source/binary/public/configuration/base identities, incomplete prefixes, inconsistent draw/lane counters, duplicate JSON keys and replay/full-solve modes; it derives no time ratio. Seven targeted CLI checks and twelve checker test methods pass, along with strict CLI lint/format, stable and Rust 1.78 docs and workflow wiring. The helper accepts all three actual Rust reports from the existing p=127 development fixture on matching 129-query prefixes. The initial inconsistent negative-test fixture and failing output are preserved. This is unsigned development correctness, not independent execution verification, a fresh 31/61-bit comparison or a speedup.
